author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Doctors at Northwestern University kept a 33-year-old man alive for 48 hours without lungs using an artificial lung device that oxygenated his blood outside the body. This life-saving technique served as a bridge to a successful double lung transplant after his lungs were irreversibly damaged by severe infection and ARDS.

Source Article: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S266663402500412X?via%3Dihub
